svg.text: The whole ~3 GiB reservation is built and torn down once per movie — 24 complete cycles, never pooled across the job.
nvcomp peaks 0.15 GiB higher (3.13 vs 2.98) — it holds the compressed strips and the inflate scratch — and finishes in 16.7 s instead of 38.7 s.
Both run at under 4% of an 80 GB card. The sawtooth is the cost: session setup plus teardown is a measured 283 ms per movie (median),
7.0 s across the traced job — for a reservation that is the same size every time. The unprofiled run is 19% shorter overall, so call it 5-7 s.
